creative_brief.emotional_promise: Nudge the moon and watch its joined star climb, crest, and return in one small desk-side orbit.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A simple one-piece Spark toy needs no assembly booklet; one compact double-sided card keeps setup, the complete interaction, recovery, care, and safety visible without a phone.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-page 7 x 5 inch landscape owner card, intended for double-sided printing
teaching_arc: Recognize the exact joined moon-and-star object
Set its long outer arc on a smooth level table
Release and observe the rise, crest, and return
Recover from poor rocking with surface and force checks
Store flat and follow concise care and safety guidance
typography: Vera Bold for promise, actions, and labels
Vera Regular for concise owner guidance
creative_brief.visual_motif: The exact jewel-like moon render anchors the dark cover; the exact three-pose signature strip becomes a numbered orbit across the light instruction side.

findings: The initial cover promise and final setup line were clipped by the render column and panel edge.
The initial back-side action cards collided with the pose markers and obscured pose captions.
resolved_changes: Reduced and reflowed the cover promise, enlarged the setup panel, and moved its final line inside the safe area.
Separated the exact three-pose strip, numbered markers, action labels, and instruction cards into distinct vertical bands.
